$comment: Metadata verified against models.dev on 2026-10-19 and confirmed by a live call the same day. Regenerate the capability fields with `oc-harness refresh mimo-v2.6-flash-free`.
title: MiMo V2.6 Flash Free
notes: Xiaomi. The only free model that publishes audio input, and it read an image correctly in a live call, at 19.2s average - the slowest lane on the tier, and slower than minimax on the same picture. OpenCode 1.19 refuses to read a binary file at all, so the audio path is not reachable through the harness today; the vision path is. No effort levels, so no variant is written.
